mapper.select: SELECT c.*, o.order_no, u.nickname AS create_by_name FROM scm_order_change c JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = c.order_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.create_by WHERE c.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY c.id DESC
SELECT i.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.unit FROM scm_order_change_item i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE i.change_id = #{changeId} ORDER BY i.id
